cases.oracle: Literal ptybroker contract and independently constructed seqpacket input and owned kernel observations; candidate output never defines the expected bytes or fixed poll control.
cases.purpose: Observe the default and explicit idle waits at the kernel syscall and check timeout parameter limits.
cases.comparison: Trace the owned peer-bound poll entry and exit, bound its blocked interval without process-start time, compare independent fixed 100 ms and early 10 ms controls, require idle status 124, queued-event acceptance of 60000 and rejection of 60001. Retain a completed result write before any supported poll witness so an attributable wrong or early status remains a failure.

cases.purpose: Retain four distinct partial-output blocks and the separately sent fixed frame.
cases.comparison: Force a 4096-byte pipe capacity, drain one raw block after each receive, compare all four retained blocks to an independent nonrepeating 16384-byte input, and retain swap, drop and duplication counterexamples. Retain and classify a reached wrong result or corrupted prefix without requiring unreached drains; an otherwise short prefix remains incomplete.
